description:
CsCheck is a C# random testing library inspired by QuickCheck.

It differs in that generation and shrinking are both based on PCG, a fast random number generator.

This gives the following advantages:

- Automatic shrinking. Gen classes are composable with no need for Arb classes. So less boilerplate.
- Random testing and shrinking are parallelized. This and PCG make it very fast.
- Shrunk cases have a seed value. Simpler examples can easily be reproduced.
- Shrinking can be continued later to give simpler cases for high dimensional problems.
- Parallel concurrency testing and random shrinking work well together.

CsCheck also makes specification, performance and regression testing simple and fast.
releaseNotes:
Added Native AOT support.
Added Spec.ConformExhaustive: checks an implementation on every transition of the proof.
Added a Self-loops column and SpecReport.Deadlock to Spec reports.
Added Faster warmUp, Check.WarmUp and CsCheck_WarmUp: wait for tiered compilation to finish before measuring.
Added net11 FrameworkTarget and Check.Equality support for C# union types.
Added Gen.Select overloads for 9 to 16 generators.
Added Gen.Int128, Gen.UInt128 and PCG.Next128.
Added range indexers to Gen.DateTime.Utc and Gen.DateTime.Local.
Added Check.SingleLimit: Single stops after 1,000,000 tries instead of hanging.
Improved Spec Sample, Conform and parallel Exhaustive speed.
Improved SampleModelBased speed: its classify table is counts only.
Improved Check.Equal and Check.EqualUnordered speed for sets and bags.
Improved SampleParallel speed with a model: replaying the model no longer starts a thread each time.
Improved CsCheckException: InnerException is set, and the stack trace points at the test.
Improved SelectMany: selectors can return IGen<R>.
Improved Faster output: it shows the JIT mode, and warns when the code may be unoptimised tier 0.
Improved Check.ChiSquared with Wilson-Hilferty correction.
Improved settings validation.
Fixed Gen.Decimal, Gen.Double and Gen.Float returning NaN or infinity, and varying by OS or .NET.
Fixed Check.Equal for dictionaries, ImmutableArray, rank 3+ arrays, ReadOnlySet and strings.
Fixed Sample hiding failures and printing the wrong value when the generator throws.
Fixed SampleParallel false failures and seed replay.
Fixed SampleModelBased writing timed operation tables when only writeLine is set.
Fixed classify tables: Op1 counting Op10, a throwing writeLine, and overflow on long runs.
Fixed Gen.Frequency with negative weights or totals over int.MaxValue.
Fixed Check.Hash with null strings, repeated HashStream.GetHashCode, and parallel test hosts.
Fixed Check.Equality accepting an assignment setter that binds as a functional one.
Fixed an action-scoped Spec.Fault applying to every action in sampled traces.
Fixed Sample, Faster and Single threads losing AsyncLocal values and culture.
Fixed Causal.Profile errors being far too small, and overflow on long runs.
Fixed threads: 0 hanging; below 1 now means the default.
Fixed Gen Faster favouring slower on large inputs: each function now gets its own freshly generated copy.
Fixed FasterAsync for 8-tuple Gens having no writeLine.
Fixed Faster returning before its threads stopped, and holding thread-pool threads for the whole run.
Fixed Faster with a seed replaying the same inputs on every thread.

BREAKING CHANGES:
- Now targets net10.0 and net11.0, version 4.9.1 was the last to target net8.0.
- Removed Gen.UInt4 to Gen.UInt2048, Gen.UInt[0, N-1] gives the same values. Gen.UInt128 now generates UInt128.
- OneOfConst and FrequencyConst are now OneOf and Frequency overloads.
- Removed Check.ModelEqual; models default to Check.Equal, so bags count duplicates.
- Removed Dbg, IRegression and RegressionExtensions; Hash.Add takes collections.
- Removed GenOperationAsync<T>. Gen.Operation with an async lambda is a compile error.
- Removed Logging.LogProcessor and Logging.CreateLogger.
- Renamed ILogger to ISampleLogger.
- Spec checks return SpecReport<S>, Exhaustive takes writeLine first, and AtMost<T> takes times after over.
- SampleFaults reports FaultOutcome.NotFound, not NotDetected, for a fault it misses.
- Generator fields such as Gen.Int.Uniform are readonly.
- Gen.Short, .Int, .UInt, .Long, .ULong, .Int128, .UInt128, .Int.Positive and .Int.NonNegative range.
- Array, Array2D, List, HashSet and ArrayUnique are extension properties for AOT.
- Invalid Check settings and CsCheck_ environment variables throw, where they used to be clamped or ignored.
- Now internal: Classifier, MedianEstimator, ThrowHelper, HashHelper, Timer types, Zigzag, Hash, MedianEstimate.
- CsCheckException.Message no longer includes the inner exception's message.
- Seeds and Check.Hash expected values change for Gen.Decimal, Gen.Double, Gen.Float.
